entries.subject: C2683716 limb-only registration
entries.finding: Only a limb-centre translation was fitted; 32.7% raster coverage, bounded illumination normalization and the analytic sphere do not establish landmark-controlled terrain.
entries.revisitWhen: A Puck camera or surface-control record permits independent interior holdouts beyond the fitted limb centre.

entries.subject: PDS Voyager ISS calibrated image C2683716
entries.finding: Included. The OPUS target-geometry inventory returned 3,054 observations; this is the finest, at 4.76965 km per original detector pixel. The next candidate is 46.31359 km/pixel, too coarse to add worthwhile mapped detail. The top-ranked inventory and full selected metadata are pinned.

entries.subject: Other Voyager filters and processed press images
entries.finding: No separately registered color observation at comparable useful resolution was located. A redistributed enlargement of the same clear image does not justify a second lens.
entries.revisitWhen: A Puck observation or controlled reconstruction demonstrates useful native surface detail, body-fixed geometry and independent registration beyond the cited sampling or coverage limits.

entries.subject: Karkoschka (2001) measured scale and PDS size catalog
entries.finding: Supports the source survey and measured scale. The catalog's DOI ending 6596 points to the companion HST paper; 6597 is the Voyager size paper. No released detailed Puck vertices/facets were located with the inspected publications. The sphere is openly approximate.

entries.subject: PDS Stooke shape release, NAIF shape releases and USGS map searches
entries.finding: No detailed scientific Puck mesh, DEM, or registered complementary surface map was located. A generic graticule layer is not a new observation. No hobbyist mesh is substituted.
entries.revisitWhen: The inspected shape archive or a cited primary release publishes a Puck-specific numerical model with its frame, units and reconstruction method.

entries.subject: Near-infrared photometry of Uranus's inner moons
entries.finding: Integrated spectral/brightness measurements are useful science but do not provide a spatially registered Puck composition or color map. Excluded as a surface lens.
entries.revisitWhen: A spatially resolved Puck measurement supplies original spectral or image samples with body-fixed coordinates and enough coverage to qualify a mapped lens.
